sents.zh: 唐朝的时候，中国很大也很有名。
sents.en: In the Tang dynasty China was large and well known.
The great city of the Tang was called Chang’an.

sents.zh: 那时候，长安是世界上最大的城。
sents.en: At that time Chang’an was the largest city in the world.

sents.zh: 城里有很多路，路很直很长。
sents.en: The city had many streets, straight and long.

sents.zh: 很多国家的商人来这里做买卖。
sents.en: Merchants from many countries came here to trade.

sents.zh: 他们带来了马、水果和好看的东西。
sents.en: They brought horses, fruit and beautiful things.

sents.zh: 城里有很多有名的诗人。
sents.en: The city had many famous poets.

sents.zh: 那时候，女人也可以读书、骑马。
sents.en: In those days women could also study and ride horses.

sents.zh: 很多人说，那是中国最好的时候之一。
sents.en: Many people say it was one of the best times in China.
